entries.title: Never use `aria-hidden` on keyboard-focusable interactive elements. Use `tabIndex={condition ? -1 : undefined}` to exclude from tab order instead. WCAG 2.1 SC 1.3.1 forbids aria-hidden on elements still in the tab order — screen readers cannot describe a focused element hidden from the accessibility tree.

entries.title: Inline `makeDebounce` should return `{ call, cancel }` instead of just the debounced function. Without `cancel()`, a stale debounce timer can fire after the action it was debouncing has already completed (e.g., a draft persist timer firing after a message is sent, re-creating the draft). Always call `cancel()` before clearing state in send/submit handlers.

entries.title: When simplifying components (removing props/UI elements), the corresponding test files accumulate stale tests that reference removed behavior. These show up as pre-existing failures in downstream tasks. Best practice: update test files in the same task that removes the behavior (TASK-003 did this correctly for ChatAreaModeControls), or dedicate a test cleanup task immediately after (TASK-007 cleaned up ChatArea.test.tsx).

entries.title: This project has no lodash or debounce utility. For debounced persistence, use a 3-line module-scope helper before the component: `function makeDebounce<T extends (...args: any[]) => void>(fn: T, delay: number) { let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>; return (...args: Parameters<T>) => { clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(() => fn(...args), delay) } }`. Wire into component via `useMemo(() => makeDebounce(persist, 350), [persist])`.

Fix: change dep to `[currentConversationId]` with `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` on the preceding line to make the intentional dep mismatch explicit.

Use `getByTitle(titleText)` as the query selector for hidden-state Trash2/similar buttons, then assert `.toHaveClass('opacity-0')` for the hidden state.

entries.title: Auto-retry loops inside React `useCallback` must use local variables (not refs) for retry tracking when the loop is a synchronous `for(;;)` with `await`. Calling `reset()` from `useSmoothStream` mid-loop triggers a re-render that can invalidate `renderHook`'s `result.current` in tests. Fix: track retries via local `let` counter, skip `reset()` calls inside the loop, use `??` instead of `||` for numeric defaults (0 is falsy with `||`).

entries.title: In custom Cypher-like graph engines, using MERGE with a match on the OLD name and SET to a NEW name can create duplicates depending on engine implementation. Safer pattern: execute a separate MATCH+SET to rename first, then MERGE on the new name for remaining property updates. This avoids the engine creating a new node if MERGE's match predicate doesn't find the pre-renamed node.

Without these handlers, tests will fall through to the generic LOAD query handler, causing false failures or silent no-ops.

entries.title: [correctness] useEffect overwrites in-progress input on conversation switch
entries.summary: useEffect(() => { setInput(persistedText) }, [persistedText]) fires whenever conversationId changes, overwriting any text the user has started typing before the async state update completes.

entries.title: [correctness] clearDraft called before send confirmation creates data loss on network failure
entries.summary: clearDraft() is called optimistically at send time. If the send fails (network error, rate limit), the draft is already gone from localStorage.

entries.title: [correctness] onOpenKnowledgePanel button always rendered when prop is undefined
entries.summary: BookmarkPlus button renders unconditionally. When onOpenKnowledgePanel is undefined, clicking it calls undefined(). Inconsistent with Trash2/Copy which have conditional render guards.

entries.title: [performance] persist() called synchronously on every keystroke
entries.summary: localStorage.setItem called synchronously on every keypress via onInputChange handler. Blocks main thread; measurable latency on lower-end hardware for long drafts.

entries.title: [performance] onInputChange inline arrow recreated on every render
entries.summary: Inline arrow (v) => { setInput(v); persist(v) } is a new reference on each ChatArea render, defeating ChatAreaComposer memoization and causing unnecessary re-renders.

entries.title: [architecture] Draft persistence logic mixed into ChatArea UI component
entries.summary: useDraftCache consumed directly in ChatArea couples persistence concern to UI layer. Draft lifecycle (when to persist, when to clear) scattered through ChatArea's render logic.

entries.title: [architecture] 4-level prop chain for onOpenKnowledgePanel
entries.summary: onOpenKnowledgePanel threaded through 4 layers: useAppShellViewModel → ChatSidebar → ChatArea → ChatAreaComposer. Adding new cross-cutting actions requires touching all 4 files.

entries.title: [architecture] ChatArea is a 1,269-line god component
entries.summary: ChatArea handles streaming, draft persistence, mode switching, tool use, selection, and rendering. Phase 1 additions make decomposition more urgent.

entries.title: [architecture] useDraftCache couples storage format to hook interface
entries.summary: Hook hardcodes localStorage and JSON format. Changing storage layer (e.g., IndexedDB for larger drafts) requires rewriting the hook interface.

entries.title: [maintainability] ChatArea.tsx at 1,269 lines exceeds maintainable size
entries.summary: Phase 1 added ~50 lines. File was already at maintainability limit. Every change requires reading the entire file to avoid regression.

entries.title: [maintainability] localStorage key prefix 'niko.draft:' is a magic string
entries.summary: Key prefix hardcoded inline. Not exported for other modules to enumerate/clear draft keys. Key name drift risk.

entries.title: [maintainability] New toolbar buttons missing focus-visible classes unlike all other interactive elements
entries.summary: The 3 new toolbar buttons (BookmarkPlus, Trash2, Copy) added in TASK-002 lack focus-visible:ring-2 classes that TASK-005/006 added to all other interactive elements. Keyboard navigation inconsistency.

entries.title: [maintainability] globals.css composer token block lacks section boundary
entries.summary: New token block has one comment but is not visually separated from sidebar tokens above. As globals.css grows, locating token groups becomes harder.

entries.title: [maintainability] ChatArea draft lifecycle undocumented in-code
entries.summary: Contract between ChatArea and useDraftCache (when to persist, when to clear, what happens on conversationId change) not documented. Future maintainers must trace the entire component to understand.

entries.title: [best-practices] useEffect for syncing state from props is a React anti-pattern
entries.summary: React docs explicitly discourage useEffect to sync derived state from props. Creates render cycle: render → effect fires → setState → re-render. Root of CORR-001.

entries.title: [best-practices] No visual feedback after clipboard copy action
entries.summary: Copy button provides no visual feedback after successful copy. Standard practice is to show a checkmark or brief toast. Users have no confirmation the action completed.

entries.title: [best-practices] clearDraft called unconditionally on send even when no draft exists
entries.summary: clearDraft() runs on every send, triggering localStorage.removeItem even when there is no draft. Unnecessary side effect on every send action.

entries.title: [best-practices] focus-visible ring on non-interactive div in AppContextFooter
entries.summary: TASK-005 added focus-visible:ring-2 to AppContextFooter's outer div. Divs without tabIndex are not focusable — these classes are dead code and misleading to future developers.

entries.title: [best-practices] Trash2 button appears/disappears without animation causing toolbar layout shift
entries.summary: Trash2 button pops in/out of existence as user types first character or deletes last. Creates jarring layout shift in the composer toolbar.

entries.title: [best-practices] BookmarkPlus button missing disabled state for unavailable contexts
entries.summary: Button is always active with no disabled state. No visual affordance for unavailability. Ties into CORR-003 (should be conditionally rendered).

entries.title: [best-practices] --composer-focus-ring token missing dark mode override
entries.summary: TASK-001 added --composer-focus-ring to :root with light mode value. .dark block has no override. Future components consuming this token will get incorrect dark mode color.

entries.title: [correctness] Clipboard writeText called without runtime API availability check
entries.summary: navigator.clipboard.writeText called with .catch(() => {}) silencing failures. Doesn't guard against navigator.clipboard being undefined in non-HTTPS or unsupported environments.

entries.title: [correctness] persistedText initial state ignores conversationId changes after mount
entries.summary: useState initializer only runs on mount. Draft restoration after conversationId change depends on the useEffect (CORR-001). Removing CORR-001's useEffect without a replacement breaks restoration.

entries.title: [correctness] useDraftCache TTL checked on load only, not on persist
entries.summary: 24h TTL validated only when loading a draft. If tab stays open across TTL boundary, persist() continues writing into an expired entry without refreshing the timestamp.

entries.title: [correctness] Snapshot tests don't validate focus-visible interactive states
entries.summary: Snapshot tests added in Phase 1 capture static rendering but don't verify that focus-visible ring changes from TASK-005 apply correctly via keyboard navigation.

entries.title: [security] localStorage draft content not size-bounded
entries.summary: No maximum size check before writing to localStorage. Very long drafts could push toward browser localStorage limits (5-10MB per origin), causing QuotaExceededError.

entries.title: [security] Clipboard receives AI-generated content without sanitization note
entries.summary: lastAssistantContent is AI-generated text written directly to clipboard. Acceptable for desktop Electron context, but assumption should be documented.

entries.title: [security] Draft key uses conversationId without format validation
entries.summary: localStorage key uses conversationId verbatim. If id contains special characters or is user-controlled, key could collide with other entries. UUID format assumed but not enforced.

entries.title: [performance] useDraftCache reads localStorage on every conversationId change without debounce
entries.summary: Rapid conversation switching triggers a localStorage read + JSON.parse on each change. Minor hit during search/navigation through conversation history.

entries.title: [performance] useLatestAssistantMessageContent re-evaluates on every streaming token
entries.summary: Selector runs on every message update including streaming tokens, potentially causing ChatAreaComposer re-renders during active AI response streaming.

entries.title: [performance] StoryBiblePanel snapshot captures hundreds of DOM nodes
entries.summary: Full container snapshot of StoryBiblePanel creates large .snap file and slow serialization. Snapshot tests that large components are anti-pattern.

entries.title: [performance] localStorage.clear() in test beforeEach runs for unrelated tests
entries.summary: Global localStorage.clear() in beforeEach of ChatArea.test.tsx runs for every test including those that don't use drafts. Minor overhead.

entries.title: [architecture] ChatAreaComposer toolbar mixes unrelated feature concerns
entries.summary: Toolbar hosts knowledge attachment (BookmarkPlus), draft management (Trash2), and conversation history (Copy) with no architectural grouping or ownership model. Will grow unbounded.

entries.title: [architecture] ChatAreaModeControls simplification removed extension points
entries.summary: TASK-003 removed showAdvanced, onSetChatMode, and advanced section. If future modes need per-mode sub-settings, the extension mechanism no longer exists.

entries.title: [architecture] Full-container snapshot tests create coupling to rendering details
entries.summary: Snapshot tests in Phase 1 capture full DOM structure including all CSS classes. Any unrelated UI change fails the snapshot, coupling test maintenance to irrelevant changes.

entries.title: [architecture] Temporal coupling between persistedText and input state initialization
entries.summary: Initial state depends on persistedText from localStorage read. The initialization order creates implicit temporal coupling not documented anywhere.

entries.title: [architecture] No abstraction layer between toolbar actions and their side effects
entries.summary: Toolbar button handlers defined inline directly calling browser APIs and prop callbacks. No unit-testable action layer exists.

entries.title: [maintainability] ChatAreaComposer props interface has grown to 13+ optional props
entries.summary: Phase 1 added 3 new optional props. Interface now has 13+ props making it unclear which are required vs optional. High cognitive load when consuming the component.

entries.title: [maintainability] useDraftCache TTL value is a magic number
entries.summary: 24h TTL computed inline as a magic number. Configuration value should be a named constant.

entries.title: [maintainability] Focus-visible class string duplicated across 8+ component files
entries.summary: TASK-005/006 copy-pasted focus ring class string into 8+ files. Any change to the focus ring style requires updating every occurrence individually.

entries.title: [maintainability] ChatAreaModeControls simplification not marked as intentional in code
entries.summary: Removal of showAdvanced, onSetChatMode, and advanced section was intentional scope reduction. Without a comment, future devs may re-add the removed infrastructure.

entries.title: [maintainability] Test assertions query by aria-label strings that can drift
entries.summary: Tests query by aria-label string 'attach context'. If the label changes, test fails with confusing error rather than a clear signal.

entries.title: [maintainability] StoryBiblePanel snapshot too large to be maintainable
entries.summary: Snapshot test renders full component creating a large .snap file. Any unrelated change to StoryBiblePanel fails the snapshot.

entries.title: [maintainability] AppContextFooter has no test coverage
entries.summary: AppContextFooter was modified in TASK-005 but has no test file. The incorrectly added focus-visible classes (BP-004) went undetected because there were no tests.

entries.title: [maintainability] Sidebar snapshot will break on every navigation item change
entries.summary: Sidebar snapshot captures full navigation tree. Adding/removing nav items will fail the snapshot, making it a merge conflict magnet.

entries.title: [maintainability] clearDraft and persist hook return types not explicitly typed
entries.summary: useDraftCache return type is inferred, not declared. Explicit types aid IDE hover documentation and catch interface changes at the call site.

entries.title: [maintainability] ChatArea.test.tsx stale test cleanup undocumented
entries.summary: TASK-007 fixed 5 pre-existing test failures in ChatArea.test.tsx but the nature of each fix is not documented. Future devs may re-introduce the removed test cases.

entries.title: [maintainability] Section header normalization may be incomplete across all knowledge tabs
entries.summary: TASK-004 normalized section headers in 3 files. Other knowledge tabs (EventTab, ThemeTab, etc.) may still use old styles if they exist.

entries.title: [best-practices] Missing aria-live region for draft-restored notification
entries.summary: When a draft is restored on conversation switch, there is no accessible announcement. Screen reader users have no way to know their previous draft was loaded.

entries.title: [best-practices] Copy button missing aria-pressed state for copy confirmation
entries.summary: After copy, button provides no state change signal to assistive technologies. aria-pressed or a status announcement would confirm the copy action to screen readers.

entries.title: [best-practices] QuickPanel search input missing autocomplete=off
entries.summary: Search inputs should have autocomplete='off' to prevent browser autofill from interfering with quick-switch functionality.

entries.title: [best-practices] AiToolbar disabled state missing aria-disabled attribute
entries.summary: TASK-006 added disabled:cursor-not-allowed CSS. HTML disabled attribute present but aria-disabled not explicitly set. Minor a11y gap.

entries.title: [best-practices] MessageBubble focus rings untested through keyboard navigation
entries.summary: TASK-006 added focus rings to 4 MessageBubble buttons but no test verifies keyboard navigation through them (tab order, focus management after action).

entries.title: [best-practices] ChatSidebar ComponentProps spread exposes all ChatArea props
entries.summary: chatAreaProps typed as ComponentProps<typeof ChatArea> and spread to ChatArea. Adding props to ChatArea automatically exposes them through ChatSidebar's interface.

entries.title: [best-practices] Sidebar active state uses raw palette classes instead of semantic tokens
entries.summary: TASK-005 active state highlight uses bg-primary-50 dark:bg-primary-900/20 — raw Tailwind values. Changing the app's active color requires updating every file that uses these classes.

entries.title: [best-practices] Snapshot tests lack update instructions in test file
entries.summary: Snapshot tests added in TASK-008 will fail after legitimate UI changes. No comment or documentation about how to update snapshots intentionally.

entries.title: [best-practices] BookmarkPlus icon semantic mismatch with knowledge panel action
entries.summary: BookmarkPlus is a 'save to bookmarks' icon. Intended action is opening the knowledge/context panel. Creates semantic disconnect for users familiar with standard iconography.

entries.title: [best-practices] onOpenKnowledgePanel naming doesn't match toggle behavior
entries.summary: Prop named onOpenKnowledgePanel but implementation toggles (opens AND closes). Misleading name creates maintenance confusion.

entries.title: [best-practices] ChatAreaModeControls tests lack negative assertions for removed functionality
entries.summary: Test file updated in TASK-003 but no tests explicitly verify the advanced section is gone. If accidentally re-added, tests won't catch it.

entries.title: [performance] PERF-006 transition-colors on all toolbar buttons adds GPU layers
entries.summary: All toolbar buttons use transition-colors which triggers GPU compositing on hover. With 5+ buttons, each hover creates a layer promotion. Minor impact on modern hardware.

entries.title: [best-practices] Trash2 aria-hidden on focusable interactive button
entries.summary: When input is empty, the Trash2 clear-draft button has aria-hidden=true but remains keyboard-focusable (no tabIndex=-1 applied). ARIA spec forbids aria-hidden on interactive elements still in tab order — keyboard users can focus a control t

entries.title: [best-practices] Copy success feedback not announced to screen readers
entries.summary: The copy button transitions aria-label from "copy last reply" to "copied!" on success, but changing aria-label in place does not reliably trigger announcements in NVDA/VoiceOver. WCAG 2.1 SC 4.1.3 requires status changes to be programmatica

entries.title: [UAT] Theme switching only affects a few buttons, not the full UI
entries.summary: Switching themes in Settings only affects a few small buttons — most of the UI does not change. Only 'follow system' works correctly. Non-system themes (charcoal, cauldron, moonbeam, etc.) partially apply.

entries.title: [UAT] Middle column bottom content clipped — novel outline only half visible
entries.summary: When scrolling to the bottom of the middle column (DocumentEditor), the novel outline section is only partially visible — bottom half is clipped/hidden. Overflow or height calculation issue.

entries.title: [UAT] Send button mouse click not working — only keyboard send works
entries.summary: The send button in the chat composer (bottom right) does not respond to mouse clicks. Users can only send messages via keyboard (Enter key). The button onClick handler exists but mouse clicks are ineffective.
